description: Product Metrics is an ecommerce advertising optimization platform that provides server-side conversion tracking, profit-based bidding signals, product segmentation, and campaign planning for stores on platforms like Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Lightspeed, and Shopware. It helps merchants send profit, customer, and lifetime-value signals to ad platforms such as Google Ads and Meta.
summary: Product Metrics exposes an OAuth-protected MCP server at https://productmetrics.io/mcp; no public REST/GraphQL API, CLI, or machine-readable HTTP API spec was found on productmetrics.io.
